history.description: A horizon of violet halftone heliotrope heads on deep ink. A vast, soft sun made of the same dots rises behind them, backlighting their edges as the flower heads slowly turn to face it.

definitions.name: scrollProgress
definitions.description: 0 to 1 from the page's sticky finale stage: 0 is dark ink, 0.3 flowers dissolved in, 0.75 sun fully risen and heads turned, 1 bottom edge dissolved back to ink.
